name: razors-edge-e2e
description: Playwright E2E harness for razors-edge (Phase 6, Task 6.2) — critical-path coverage for the dark-luxe barbershop showcase: landing SSR/CSP smoke, the booking happy path (the centerpiece), deep-link preselect, form validation, the availability grid, keyboard operation, reduced-motion hero, and the theme toggle. Runs against a built + served Next app on :3070 (NOT next dev, per the project's strict-CSP/GSAP discipline). Point at any deployed URL via the BASE_URL env var.
